skill.name: douyin-product-research
skill.description: Guides Douyin product research through SocialDataX, using category, budget, and service filters to produce candidate lists with evidence and verification questions.
skill.summary: Shortlist Douyin products and review selected details through the SocialDataX CLI or corresponding MCP tools.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most alerts are false positives from Markdown backticks, Chinese text, product identifiers, and documented service authentication. The CLI examples execute an unpinned npm package through npx, creating dependency execution risk. No evidence found of prompt injection or credential theft in the supplied files; the external package implementation was not included.

remediation.issue: The CLI examples use npx -y socialdatax-skills@latest, executing mutable third-party code without an installation confirmation prompt.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed version and verify package integrity through a lockfile. Obtain explicit approval before installation and execution with service credentials.

content.value_statement: Douyin product selection requires consistent filtering and traceable evidence. This skill guides SocialDataX searches and detail reviews to produce focused shortlists with clear verification questions.
actual_capabilities: Guides keyword searches with optional price bounds, sorting, official-store, dispatch, shipping-insurance, and return filters.
Documents product-detail lookup by product ID or URL through direct CLI commands and corresponding MCP tools.
Starts with one results page, displays up to five candidates, and reviews two or three relevant product details.
Organizes returned names, prices, specifications, shops, links, and missing fields into a traceable Markdown shortlist.
Separates product claims from evidence and identifies questions requiring further verification.
Defines bounded retries and continuation-token recovery while preserving partial results and original query limits.
limitations: Live retrieval requires SocialDataX access, SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY, available service credits, and a working CLI or configured MCP connection.
The supplied files contain workflow instructions, not the external CLI implementation; runtime behavior and data accuracy were not independently verified.
Small candidate samples do not establish market size, true sales, growth, market share, or future product performance.
The workflow does not retrieve product reviews or calculate profit without user-provided costs and fees.

use_cases.title: Build an initial shop shortlist
use_cases.description: Filter a product category by budget and required service conditions, then review the strongest candidates before sourcing decisions.

use_cases.title: Prepare a category comparison
use_cases.description: Compare returned prices, specifications, and shop details while identifying missing evidence and avoiding unsupported market conclusions.

use_cases.title: Verify a sourcing candidate
use_cases.description: Review a supplied product ID or URL and list specification, service, and cost questions that require supplier confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Start a category search
prompt_templates.prompt: Research Douyin products for [category]. Fetch one page, show up to five candidates, and review two relevant details. Mark unavailable fields.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: create a first shortlist from one category.

prompt_templates.title: Apply budget and service filters
prompt_templates.prompt: Find [category] products priced between [minimum] and [maximum] yuan. Require official stores and seven-day returns. Explain matches and exclusions using returned evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: compare candidates against explicit purchasing requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Review selected product details
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these Douyin product IDs or URLs: [items]. Include returned prices, specifications, shops, sources, and observation time. Separate seller claims from evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Experienced: investigate a shortlist before supplier discussions.

prompt_templates.title: Continue an incomplete comparison
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume this partial search: [saved results, query, limits, and continuation token]. Deduct completed pages and items. Preserve evidence and flag unresolved errors.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: recover a bounded research task without repeating completed pages.

output_examples.input: Using my supplied records, compare Storage Box A at 39 yuan and Storage Box B at 59 yuan against a 50-yuan budget.
output: Source: user-provided records; no live lookup performed.
Storage Box A: 39 yuan; within budget. Specifications, store, product link, and service conditions were not provided.
Storage Box B: 59 yuan; excluded because it exceeds the stated budget.
Priority verification: confirm Box A specifications, current price, store identity, and return conditions before selection.

output_examples.input: Summarize my partial search: three candidates returned, one detail checked, network failure, and no continuation token.
output: Status: incomplete. Three candidates were returned, but only one detail record was checked.
Preserve available records and the network error. Do not imply that all results were retrieved.
No continuation token was provided. Do not restart automatically from page one.
Further comparison requires the saved query, remaining limits, and a valid continuation token.

best_practices: Start with one category and explicit budget or service requirements; keep the first search to one page.
Retain source links or product IDs and observation time; mark missing fields instead of guessing.
Approve dependency installation explicitly, prefer a reviewed pinned package version, and keep service credentials out of prompts and reports.
anti_patterns: Treating search order or a small sample as proof of platform-wide sales rank or market size.
Inventing reviews, growth rates, profit margins, or product success predictions from incomplete records.
Repeating failed searches without checking balance errors, continuation tokens, and remaining result limits.

faq.question: What information is needed to start?
faq.answer: A category or product keyword is enough. Add budget, audience, and service requirements when available.

faq.question: Does live research require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY for SocialDataX access. Service credits may be required; manage credentials through the provider website.

faq.question: Can I use CLI commands instead of MCP?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents direct CLI commands and corresponding MCP tools. CLI use requires Node.js, npm, and permission to execute dependencies.

faq.question: Does the workflow modify my Douyin account?
faq.answer: The instructions specify read-only research without login or account actions. The external CLI implementation was not included for verification.

faq.question: Can it predict sales or profitability?
faq.answer: No. It compares returned product information. It does not infer true sales or success probability; profit estimates require supplied costs and fees.

faq.question: What happens after an incomplete result or balance error?
faq.answer: Keep partial records and errors. Stop repeated balance-error retries. Resume only with a valid continuation token and the original remaining limits.
